authorized-by.reason: v0.3 Phase 2 / change #E: expose new MCP tools so gatekeeper, architect, swe, pr-reviewer can capture intent (discussion_*), enumerate open issues at session start (issue_list), bind tasks to spec files (task_set_spec_path), log commit SHAs atomically with status flips (task_update_status commit_sha extension), and generate read-only snapshots of issue state for PR review (issue_snapshot_md). All Phase 2 agent prompt rewrites depend on these tools existing.

task.title: Add MCP tools: discussion_append, discussion_list, issue_get_with_discussions, issue_list, task_set_spec_path, issue_snapshot_md + extend task_update_status with commit_sha
task.description:
With the `discussions` table and `tasks.task_spec_path` column in place, add the MCP tools that downstream agents will call. Six new tools plus one extension to an existing tool, across four files.
NEW FILE: `mcp/trajectory-server/src/tools/discussions.ts` — follow the existing module pattern (`issues.ts` is the closest analogue: factory function returning `{ definitions, handlers }`, `wrapHandler` for error capture, `normalizeAgent` middleware where redaction matters).
Tools to expose:
1. `discussion_append(agent, issue_id, author, kind?, body_md)` → Insert one discussion row. `author` and `kind` validated against allowed sets. Returns the inserted row. - allowed `author`: any non-empty string (caller responsibility) - allowed `kind`: 'intent' | 'question' | 'answer' | 'decision' | 'note' (default 'note')
2. `discussion_list(agent, issue_id, limit?, offset?)` → Return discussions for an issue ordered by `created_at ASC`. Default limit 50, max 200. Used by snapshot generation and by gatekeeper at session resume.
3. `issue_get_with_discussions(agent, issue_id)` → Convenience: returns the issue row + its full discussion list + its task list (id, branch_id, status, title). Single round-trip instead of three calls.
4. `issue_list(agent, status?, limit?, offset?)` → Enumerate issues for the gatekeeper pre-scan. Returns an array of `{id, objective, status, created_at, updated_at}` ordered by `updated_at DESC`. Optional `status` filter (any value from the issues.status enum: 'open' | 'in_progress' | 'closed' | etc. — match whatever the existing schema allows). Default limit 50, max 200. No body/discussions returned — this is a thin index call. Used by gatekeeper at session start to decide whether to resume an in-flight issue or start fresh.
5. `task_set_spec_path(agent, issue_id, branch_id, spec_path)` → Update `tasks.task_spec_path` for the row matching (issue_id, branch_id). Validate that `spec_path` matches the expected pattern `docs/trustmybot/tasks/<branch_id_filename>.md` where `<branch_id_filename>` is the branch_id with `/` → `-` (the filename convention is documented in `docs/trustmybot/SPEC-FORMAT.md` — see Phase 2 task `markdown-spec-format-doc`). For this task, enforce only the regex `^docs/trustmybot/tasks/[a-z0-9-]+\.md$` and the `<type>-<slug>` substring sanity check (`branch_id.replace('/', '-')` MUST appear in the filename stem).
6. `issue_snapshot_md(agent, issue_id, output_path?)` → Generate a read-only markdown snapshot at `docs/trustmybot/snapshots/<issue_id>.md` (default) summarizing: - Issue header (id, objective, status, created_at, branch_id of current_task_id if any) - Discussion log (timestamp + author + kind + body) - Task list (branch_id, status, title, task_spec_path, commit_sha if present) - A "GENERATED" header with timestamp and the line: `<!-- Generated by issue_snapshot_md. Do not edit; regenerate. -->` Returns `{ path, bytes_written }`. Creates the snapshots dir if it does not exist. Overwrites any existing file at the path. Honors an explicit `output_path` argument when provided (used by PR reviewer to write a review-time snapshot to a temp path).
EXTENSION to existing tool — `task_update_status` (in `tasks.ts`): Add an OPTIONAL `commit_sha` parameter to the existing tool signature. When provided, the handler MUST persist it onto the same row in the SAME transaction as the status update — atomic. This requires a `tasks.commit_sha` column; if the column does not yet exist (check `phase-2-schema-discussions-and-spec-path` — verify the schema task added it; if not, ESCALATE to architect rather than silently adding a column here). SWE flips `status='completed'` and logs the SHA of the commit it just made in one call, eliminating the race where status updates without a SHA. When `commit_sha` is omitted the tool behaves exactly as before (back-compat). Validate the SHA loosely: 40-char hex (full) or 7+ char hex (short) — reject anything containing non-hex characters. Returns the updated row including the new `commit_sha` field.
REGISTRATION: edit `mcp/trajectory-server/src/tools/index.ts` to import the new modules. Module placement: - Add `discussion_append`, `discussion_list`, `issue_get_with_discussions` to a NEW `discussions.ts` module. - Add `issue_list` to the existing `issues.ts` module (it's a thin issues-table read). - Add `task_set_spec_path` to the existing `tasks.ts`. - Extend `task_update_status` in the existing `tasks.ts` with the optional `commit_sha` parameter (no new tool — modify in place, preserve the existing `Tool` definition name). - Add `issue_snapshot_md` to the existing `reports.ts`. - Wire the new module into `tools/index.ts`. Existing modules auto-pick-up their new tools; verify the merged registry.
Edge cases the implementer MUST handle: - `discussion_append` with unknown `kind` → 400-style error string, not silent default. Lists allowed values in the message. - `discussion_list` for an unknown `issue_id` → return empty array with a `warning: "issue not found"` field, not throw. - `issue_list` with no rows → return `[]`, not an error. With an unknown `status` filter → reject with the allowed set listed. - `task_set_spec_path` with a path that does NOT contain the sanitized branch_id → throw with the expected vs actual filename. - `task_update_status` with `commit_sha` containing non-hex characters or shorter than 7 chars → reject before opening the transaction. Status update MUST NOT happen if SHA validation fails. Existing callers that omit `commit_sha` MUST continue to work (back-compat is non-negotiable). - `issue_snapshot_md` when `docs/trustmybot/snapshots/` does not exist → create with `mkdir -p` semantics (Node `fs.mkdirSync` with `recursive: true`). - `issue_snapshot_md` writing to a path OUTSIDE `docs/trustmybot/` → reject. Snapshots are scoped to the workflow dir.

files.file: New module mirroring `issues.ts` shape. Three tools: `discussion_append`, `discussion_list`, `issue_get_with_discussions`. Use the same `wrapHandler` / `requireArg` / `ok` / `err` helpers (copy them from `issues.ts` — there is no shared helpers module yet, and a Phase 3 refactor can extract them). Use `normalizeAgent` for the `agent` parameter.

Add `issue_list` definition and handler alongside the existing issue tools. Use the same `wrapHandler` / `requireArg` / `ok` / `err` helpers and `normalizeAgent` middleware. Returns the array directly; no envelope. Validate `status` against the issues.status enum if provided.

Two changes: (a) Add `task_set_spec_path` definition and handler. Filename regex validation as described. Update the row by (issue_id, branch_id); throw if no row matched. Returns the updated row. (b) Extend the existing `task_update_status` Tool definition's inputSchema with an OPTIONAL `commit_sha` property. Update the handler to validate the SHA (hex, >=7 chars) BEFORE opening the transaction, then write `status` and (if provided) `commit_sha` in the SAME `UPDATE` statement so the two persist atomically. Existing callers that don't pass `commit_sha` keep working — the column is left unchanged. Schema dependency: this requires `tasks.commit_sha` to exist; confirm via the depends-on task `phase-2-schema-discussions-and-spec-path` before implementing. If absent, ESCALATE.

Add `issue_snapshot_md` definition and handler. Reuse the existing Markdown rendering style if `issue_report_md` already produces one; otherwise template a fresh one with sections: Header / Discussions / Tasks. Use `node:fs` for write; resolve `output_path` against project root via `process.cwd()`. Reject paths that do not start with `docs/trustmybot/`.

Import `discussionTools` from `./discussions.js`, add it to the `definitions` and `handlers` arrays in the same alphabetical / logical order as the others. Existing `tasks` and `reports` modules automatically pick up their new tools — no extra wiring beyond verifying the new tool names appear in the merged registry.

task.success-criteria: - 6 new tool names appear in the registered MCP tool list: `discussion_append`, `discussion_list`, `issue_get_with_discussions`, `issue_list`, `task_set_spec_path`, `issue_snapshot_md`. - `task_update_status` accepts an OPTIONAL `commit_sha` parameter and persists it on the same row in the same transaction as the status update. Calls without `commit_sha` continue to work unchanged (back-compat). - Build passes: `npm --prefix mcp/trajectory-server run build`. - Existing tools continue to work (no regression in tool count besides the +6 new tools, no broken handler bindings). - Each new tool has a top-level `description` string in its `Tool` definition so MCP discovery shows useful help. - `discussion_append` with an invalid `kind` returns an error result (`isError: true`) and lists the allowed values in the message. - `issue_list` returns rows in `updated_at DESC` order with only the documented fields (id, objective, status, created_at, updated_at) — no body, no discussions, no tasks. - `task_set_spec_path` rejects a path whose filename stem does not contain the sanitized branch_id. - `task_update_status({status:'completed', commit_sha:'abc1234'})` persists BOTH fields in one transaction. Reading the row back via `task_get` (or equivalent) returns the SHA on the `commit_sha` column. SHA round-trips byte-for-byte. - `task_update_status` rejects `commit_sha:'not-hex!'` and `commit_sha:'abc'` (too short) without flipping the status. - `issue_snapshot_md` writes a file containing the GENERATED header, the issue objective, the discussion entries, the task list, and the commit_sha when present on a task row.
task.out-of-scope: - Shell-level helper for hooks to query SQLite (Phase 2 task `hook-sqlite-migration`). - Agent prompt rewrites that call these tools (later Phase 2 tasks). - A real schema for discussion authors (validated against an enum) — keep `author` free-form for now; the agent name is the convention. - Replacing `issue_report_md` with `issue_snapshot_md` (they are sibling tools; the report stays for end-of-issue summaries, the snapshot is for in-flight review handoff).

task.commit:
🛠️ feat(mcp): add discussion + issue_list + snapshot tools; extend task_update_status with commit_sha
Six new MCP tools (discussion_append, discussion_list, issue_get_with_discussions, issue_list, task_set_spec_path, issue_snapshot_md) plus a commit_sha extension to task_update_status so SWE can flip status and log the SHA atomically. These let gatekeeper enumerate open issues at session start, capture conversational intent into SQLite, bind tasks to their on-disk markdown specs, and generate read-only snapshots for PR review — replacing the GOALS/DISCUSSION/BLUEPRINT file workflow as the canonical state path.
